p: separate themselves from the holy things: Meaning, that the priests abstain from eating, as long as they are polluted.
goeth unto the holy things: To eat of it.
unclean by the dead: By touching any dead thing, or being at burial of the dead.
stranger eat of the holy thing: Which is not of the tribe of Levi.
sojourner of the priest: Some read, the servant who had his ear bored, and would not go free, Ex 21:6.
stranger: Who is not of the priests kindred.
fifth part thereof unto it: He shall give that and a fifth part over.
trespass: For if they did not offer sacrifice for their error, the people by their example might commit the same offence.
from a stranger's hand shall ye: You shall not receive any imperfect thing from a stranger, to make it the Lord's offering: which he calls the bread of the Lord.
profane my holy name: For whoever does otherwise than God commands pollutes his Name.
